author: Ryan Daws
description:
Java developers are simultaneously abandoning Oracle’s distribution to cut costs while expanding their use of the language to support production-grade AI. The 2026 State of Java Survey and Report, published by Azul and based on responses from over 2,000 Java professionals, identifies a defensive transition away from unpredictable licensing fees alongside an offensive move to […]

title: Developers adopt high-performance Java to support production AI
